chapter: Central Avenue clubs, Nordskog, Sheffield and Music Town
title: The date of An American Rhapsody at the Mayan Theatre
summary: Spikes and Willard try to date the Music Town production at the Mayan Theatre, which was about a year after Jump For Joy.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: So this production--is there a date on here? "Salome"...
Let's see. Ain't there a date on that? Huh. Maybe this [souvenir program] was given away inside. I don't know. It says, "September, the 15th" now. I don't know what year it was. I
think it was about...well, see here, it says, "Opening Thursday, September the 15th" but it don't say what year, does it?

No, but I guess we could look at a calendar from then and find out what year September the 15th was on Thursday, and we could find out--because it would be around '42 sometime, right? Was this...I noticed here--this "American Rhapsody" production--"Music Town Presents" but it was at the Mayan Theatre. Is that right? It says, "Mayan Theatre" down here.
Yeah, that's where they had that.
But it was your group. I mean, the production came out of Music Town.
Yeah, the dance teachers there had it.
And it was put on at the Mayan Theatre, and this would be about a year after "Jump For Joy" was a hit at the Mayan. Did you see "Jump For Joy"?
No, I never did see it but I knew... I was here when it was operating.
